note: Temenos Furnace (Alabaster Matter / Murky Matter) Rank 30 rows. The Alabaster Mantle, Murky Mantle and Murky Ring carry fixed standard-augment picks: each pick is the client's standard augment id and its five-bit value, so the block renders through capes.describe and augment_stats. Rows are listed the way the wiki groups them; the client prints two two-stat rows (Accuracy+Attack and Ranged Accuracy+Attack) because it has no combined Accuracy+Ranged Accuracy id. The Alabaster Earring's All Attr.+10 row has no standard augment id, but client bundle 468 carries exactly its three Rank 30 rows, so the earring uses a bundle block instead.
